recorded.letter:
**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM)  
**Order Date:** June 18, 2025  
**Patient Condition:** Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with Hyperglycemia

---

**Approval Rationale:**

All medical necessity criteria have been met.

**Criterion 1 – Diabetes Diagnosis:** Met. Medical record documents active Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia (E11.65), established 2016.

**Criterion 2 – Insulin Therapy:** Met. Patient is currently on active insulin therapy with insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime, initiated March 2, 2023.

**Criterion 3 – Recent Practitioner Visit:** Met. In-person diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. K. O'Neill on April 29, 2025 (50 days prior to order). Visit included review of glucose log and HbA1c, assessment of diabetes control and hypoglycemia risk, and discussion of continuous glucose monitoring.

---

**Authorization Details:**

This authorization covers the continuous glucose monitor as ordered. Please submit claims with this authorization reference.

If you have questions, contact our office.
